origine_fr: Le chien 犬 et 黑, qui donnait le son mais se lit hēi, plus mò. Le premier sens est « chien qui court sans bruit après quelqu'un ». Du chien qui ne jappe pas est resté le silence.
origine_en: The dog 犬 plus 黑, which gave the sound but is read hēi, not mò. It first meant “a dog silently chasing someone”. What remains of the dog that does not bark is the silence.

phrase.en: He was silent for a long time.
